svg.text: n_hidden 512 (registers) · c_context 384 · 8×8 grid · depth 8 · 9 context DFFs in a RESIDUAL CASCADE, FIXED octave windows 256 … 2, 1, reads scaled by running RMS · token RMS-normed · reset to 0 at <STX> · one shared linout · concatenated read, no text_proj · batch 250 · RMSprop lr 1e-5 · smol fineweb-edu (1 shard)
next token → fed back as the next step's input (autoregressive)
dashed: old state r (Q) into each EMA · open circle R: every DFF resets to 0 at <STX>
each read through its own 512-channel block of ctx_cat
context DFFs: 9-stage residual cascade, octave windows, running-RMS reads
reset to 0 at every <STX>; the first write blends from 0, so each register is a
running average of the current document only (registers detached: 1-step gradient)
DFF_1 ← EMA_256(x) · DFF_k ← EMA_Wk(x − DFF_k−1[t]), W_k = 256 / 2^(k−1)
DFF_9 ← x − DFF_8[t] (W = 1: a plain write)
each stage subtracts only the next-slower register (not the sum of all of them)
DFF_k[t] is the value written this step: 8 subtract → EMA stages settle in one clock
token grid: each embedding row scaled to RMS 1 (frozen, so folded into the ROM)
read side: DFF_k × 1/σ_k, σ_k = running batch RMS (train-time EMA, momentum 0.01)
a constant at inference: folds into ctx_cat's weights (no reduction, no rsqrt)
conv 3×3 unpadded (linear, no BN/ReLU): dec_tree.0, dec_tree.1, decoder.proj
EMA multiply-accumulate, rate 1/W_k (fixed: 256 … 2; DFF_9 is a plain write)
subtractor: x minus the next-slower register's new value
read scale 1/σ_k (running RMS; constant at inference)
D flip-flop, clocked once per token step; R = synchronous reset to 0
data / state path (labelled where it matters)
old register value r into its EMA
Per token: ≈878M conv MAC (679M ContextCNN, 132M 1×1s, 54M decoder, 13M lmhead)
